description: Developers need to verify that webhook events preserve required fields, nesting, and array shapes across example payloads before wiring integrations.

expected_shape_json.description: Accept a JSON object describing the required webhook shape. Must parse as valid JSON and represent an object or array-shaped contract. Empty input is invalid.

payload_samples.description: Accept one or more JSON payload samples as pasted text. Each sample must parse as valid JSON. Multiple samples may be separated by blank lines or labeled blocks. Empty input is invalid.

show_path_details.description: When true, output includes JSON-pointer-like paths for every mismatch and extra field. When false, only summarized path groups are required in the output.

strict_mode.description: When true, any missing required path, type mismatch, enum mismatch, array shape mismatch, or extra top-level path outside permissive rules marks the result incompatible.

name: webhook-payload-shape-sanity-checker
title: Webhook Payload Shape Sanity Checker
